chapter: Learning the drums and early influences
title: Teaching himself drums and learning paradiddles from Cozy Cole
summary: He had no teacher, learned on the job in Lunceford's band, and later asked Cozy Cole how to play ratamacues and paradiddles.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: So now, when you started playing the drums --
The drums?
Thank you. When you started playing the drums, how -- what did you (inaudible)?
I didn't have no formal education on drums. I didn't have a teacher or nothing. I just sat behind them and just started to banging on them in Lunsford's band.
Well, during high school?
During high school, Lakeside, Ohio,
Cleveland, Buffalo, on the territory run in that vicinity.
So did you -- what kind of things did you have to play in those days? Did you have to play --
Just regular -- just try to play swing and jazz drums.
Now, did you -- what I'm saying is like did you -- how did you learn --
To play music?
Play like you roll -- different rolls and --
Rolls?
-- and different kinds of beats?

I guess I was a natural. I finally heard -- I'm jumping a little bit. I finally heard Cozy Cole playing a solo known as Ratamacue. That's what it sounded like, Ratamacue. And Paradiddles is the name of it, paradiddle, paradiddle. In other words, paradiddle, paradiddle, see how my hands are going? Right, left, right, right, left, left, so on. So I asked Cozie, I said, how do you execute that? So he told me. It's in there in the book. I said, what book?
And I got this book that I learned how to do my ratamakes and the paradiddles. Rolls, I always had some kind of rolls. And I did that. And so --
So now, what year is this that we've
been --
When I did what?
When you talked -- when you talked to him about the drums.
Oh, just when he was with either Callaway Caraway or one of the other bands, we put out a record on paradiddles.
Yeah, I have that record.

Yeah. He said, this is the most swinging rudiment to me of all of them, ratamakes and all the five stroke rolls, seven stroke rolls, said the paradiddle is the most swinging, Craw. They called me Craw back in those days and still do. May I smoke?
Yeah, oh, sure.
Will you have one?
